target: workflow.sh diff — a nested begin (a second begin while one is already open) exits 3
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/workflow-fixture.sh"; wf_file project.js '// @agentic-loop:begin region=outer owner=plugin' 'console.log("outer");' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=inner owner=plugin' 'console.log("inner");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=inner' '// @agentic-loop:end region=outer'; wf_file template.js '// @agentic-loop:begin region=outer owner=plugin' 'console.log("outer");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=outer'; workflow_diff project.js template.js '//' '{}' >/dev/null 2>diff.err; DIFF_EXIT=$?; jq -n --argjson exitcode $DIFF_EXIT --arg err "$(cat diff.err)" '{exit:$exitcode, stderr:$err}'; exit "$DIFF_EXIT"
_note: Covers the diff path (workflow-204 covers merge) for the other structural-corruption class: a begin encountered while a region is still open. This guards against a scanner that only checks for unclosed-at-EOF and misses mid-file nesting.
